derivation: amendment A1: a page with one reciprocal internal target (en to B, returned) and one target outside the manifest reports exactly one informational `hreflang_external_target` and exits 0.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="es" href="https://other.example/x">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>
